title: Russian Wrap
description: A flavorful Russian-inspired wrap filled with spicy frankfurter, fresh herbs, and sweet currants.

ingredients.name: Fresh Herbal Sprigs
ingredients.notes: such as parsley, dill, or basil

instructions: Preheat a pan or griddle over medium-high heat.
Add the frankfurter and cook until heated through, about 2-3 minutes.
Meanwhile, toast the wrap by warming it in the same pan or by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wrap by spreading the frankfurter on the bottom half of the wrap, followed by a sprinkle of Russian seasoning, salt, and pepper.
Top with chopped fresh herbs and currants.
Fold the wrap in half to enclose the filling.
